name: Yakumo Miyu
source:
She is Rio's younger sister and attends a different school than her older sister.

She has a very gentle personality and is laid back in her actions. She is
shy and not very good at talking to people, so she doesn't have many friends.

She excels at studying, but is terrible at sports.

She is a bit of a sister complex, and is often found following Rio around.
